title: Route deployment credentials through scoped secret references (VC-201-066)
goal: VC-201-066 refuted: SecretRef/SecretVault/redact_for_export and KeyRef/resolve_key_ref have zero production callers — real provider credentials flow through cloud.env/plaintext api_key fields; plan/export/tracing never invoke redaction. Also redact_for_export only masks a whitespace-delimited resolved= token (JSON fields and space-containing values leak), and the scope guard is a caller-asserted string, not an enforced boundary. Evidence: crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_066_mastery.rs.
